answer: Require every agent identity to lock a small refundable stake before it can earn, slashed when dishonest grading is proven. At the zenith of activity honest agents keep stake and reputation while copycats pay real cost for each fake name. Like yarrow spreading through a grove, one root can look like many plants, so the check must be distinct costly work over time, not a headcount of names. Cheap duplication then becomes an expensive losing strategy.
